ops.en: a part, device, or accessory attached to something else
ops.cn: 附件；附属部件；连接在其他物体上的装置或配件

ops.en: a strong emotional bond, affection, or feeling of connection to a person, place, idea, or thing
ops.cn: 依恋；感情纽带；对人、地点、观念或事物的情感连接

ops.en: a file, document, image, or other item attached to an email or message
ops.cn: 邮件或消息附件；随电子邮件、消息发送的文件、文档或图片

ops.en: reliable, official, or convincing because it comes from recognized knowledge, expertise, or authority
ops.cn: 权威可靠的；因来自公认的知识、专业能力或权威来源而可信的

ops.en: commanding, confident, and likely to be respected or obeyed
ops.cn: 有威严的；命令式而自信、容易令人服从或信服的

boundaries.note: Common British spelling of the same noun.

ops.en: the act or process of classifying things, people, or ideas into categories
ops.cn: 分类；把事物、人或观念归入不同类别的过程

ops.en: formal: the beginning or start of something
ops.cn: （正式）开始；开端

ops.en: American English: a graduation ceremony, especially at a college or university
ops.cn: （美式）毕业典礼；尤指大学毕业典礼

ops.en: an official appointed to manage, supervise, regulate, or lead a public body, department, league, agency, or commission
ops.cn: 专员；委员；受任管理、监督或监管公共机构、部门、联盟、机关或委员会的官员

ops.en: the act or process of compensating for work, service, loss, injury, or disadvantage
ops.cn: 补偿；赔偿；对工作、服务、损失、伤害或不利情况进行补偿的行为

ops.en: money, payment, reward, or another benefit given for work, service, loss, injury, or disadvantage
ops.cn: 报酬；赔偿金；补偿款；因工作、服务、损失或伤害而给予的钱款或利益

ops.en: relating to concepts, ideas, theories, or an abstract mental model rather than concrete implementation or physical detail
ops.cn: 概念性的；与概念、思想、理论或抽象模型有关而非具体实施或物理细节的

ops.meaning_cn: 符合某规则、标准或要求；与某事保持一致

ops.en: agreement, uniformity, or lack of contradiction among parts, statements, actions, or behavior
ops.cn: 一致性；连贯性；各部分、说法、行为之间相符而不矛盾

ops.en: the thickness, texture, firmness, or degree of fluidity of a substance or mixture
ops.cn: 稠度；质地；物质或混合物的厚薄、软硬或流动程度

ops.en: the body of voters in an electoral area who elect a representative
ops.cn: 选区选民；某一选区内选举代表的全体投票者

ops.en: a group of people represented, served, supported, or relied on by an organization, official, institution, or movement
ops.cn: 代表对象；服务群体；支持基础；某机构、官员或运动所代表、服务或依赖的人群

ops.meaning_cn: 与某人商议后；在征求某人意见或建议后

ops.en: the act or process of making, producing, or bringing something into existence
ops.cn: 创造；创作；使某物产生或存在的过程

ops.en: something that has been created, made, or produced
ops.cn: 创作品；创造物；被创造或制作出来的东西

ops.en: the ability to produce original, imaginative, valuable, or useful ideas, solutions, or works
ops.cn: 创造力；产生原创、有想象力、有价值或实用的想法、方案或作品的能力

ops.en: reasoning from general principles or premises to a particular conclusion
ops.cn: 演绎；从一般原则或前提推导出具体结论的推理

ops.en: an amount subtracted or withheld from pay, tax, a price, an account, or another total
ops.cn: 扣除额；从工资、税款、价格、账户或总额中减去、扣留的一笔金额

ops.en: a clear showing, proof, example, or display that establishes or illustrates something
ops.cn: 证明；展示；示范；用论证、证据、例子或展示说明某事

ops.en: a practical display or explanation showing how something works or how to do something
ops.cn: 演示；示范操作；展示某物如何工作或某事如何完成

ops.en: a public gathering or march in which people express opposition, support, or demands
ops.cn: 示威；游行；公众集会表达反对、支持或诉求

ops.en: derived, obtained, or developed from another source; sometimes lacking originality because it closely follows earlier work
ops.cn: 派生的；源自其他来源的；有时指模仿性强、缺乏原创的

ops.en: something derived, developed, or obtained from another source
ops.cn: 派生物；衍生品；由其他来源发展或获得的事物

ops.value: Mathematical and financial derivative senses are specialist domains and should be separated rather than collapsed into the ordinary derived-from-source concept.

ops.en: the act or process of moving something from its usual position, replacing one thing with another, or changing position
ops.cn: 移位；置换；把某物从原位移开、以一物替代另一物或发生位置变化

ops.en: the forced or involuntary movement of people or populations away from their homes or communities
ops.cn: 流离失所；人口被迫离开家园或社区的迁移

ops.value: Physics displacement remains a domain-specific application of change in position.

ops.en: the state or condition of having control, superiority, influence, or predominance over others
ops.cn: 支配；优势；主导地位；某人、群体、特征或力量相对于其他对象占据控制或优势的状态

ops.en: control or the exercise of power over a person, group, place, or system, often in an oppressive or coercive way
ops.cn: 统治；支配；对人、群体、地区或系统施加控制和权力，常带压迫或强制意味

ops.value: domination emphasizes exercise of control/power, often coercive; dominance can also mean predominance or superiority without the same coercive implication.
